_meta.source: corpus/law_paragraphs.jsonl — official German text of OR Art. 253-273c (Fedlex, version 2026-10-01) plus OR Art. 143 and 544
_meta.method: Pass 1: one entry drafted per paragraph from the German text and its internal cross-references only. Pass 2: each German paragraph re-read against its entry; every change is listed in review_log. Where the text allowed a wider or narrower gate, the narrower one was taken and the note says so.
_meta.status: Claude-built, checked by a second Claude pass; not reviewed by a lawyer

fields.needs_all: every listed event must be confirmed for the paragraph to apply
fields.needs_any: at least one listed event must be confirmed (if the list is non-empty)
fields.excludes: rules this paragraph switches off: the named paragraph/article does not apply when 'when' holds
fields.premises: all = any rented thing; residential_and_business = Wohn- und/oder Geschäftsräume; business_only = Geschäftsräume; other = another limit, stated at the start of note ('Premises: ...')
fields.deciding_facts: client facts that decide whether/how the paragraph applies once its events are confirmed
fields.general: true = definition or general rule needing no event
fields.no_gate: general=false with empty needs_all and needs_any = no menu event gates it; relevance turns on deciding_facts only

events.E1: The landlord (or a new owner) has given notice of termination of the tenancy.
events.E2: The tenant, or one of several co-tenants, has given notice of termination or has decided to give it.
events.E3: The landlord has set a written payment deadline threatening termination if the arrears are not paid (Art. 257d Abs. 1).
events.E4: The rented property has a defect, or the tenant is disturbed in its contractual use (including by a third party claiming a right to it).
events.E5: The landlord has given notice of a rent increase or of another unilateral change to the lease at the tenant's expense (e.g. new ancillary costs, reduced services).
events.E6: The tenant has returned the property / moved out.
events.E7: The tenancy has ended (by notice, expiry of a fixed term, agreement or otherwise).
events.E8: The tenant is married or in a registered partnership and the rented flat serves as the family home.
events.E9: The tenant is behind with rent or ancillary costs that are already due.
events.E10: The payment deadline set under Art. 257d has passed without full payment.
events.E11: The tenant wants to sublet or has sublet all or part of the property, or the client is a subtenant.
events.E12: The property has been sold or has otherwise changed owner (incl. loss in debt-enforcement or bankruptcy proceedings, or a limited real right equivalent to a change of owner), or such a transfer is under way.
events.E13: The tenant has provided a security deposit (cash or securities).
events.E14: The lease is fixed-term (it ends on an agreed date without notice).
events.E15: The tenant shares the lease with one or more co-tenants.
events.E16: An extension of the tenancy (Erstreckung) has been granted by the authority or agreed between the parties.
events.E17: The tenant has died (the heirs are dealing with the lease).
events.E18: The tenant has been declared bankrupt after taking over the property.
events.E19: The landlord carries out or has announced works, renovations, changes or viewings of the property.
events.E20: The tenant is about to take over or has recently taken over the property (start of the tenancy).
events.E21: The landlord has sent a written warning (Mahnung) about the tenant's lack of care or consideration (e.g. noise, damage, nuisance).

OR Art. 253.note: Definition of the lease contract ('Durch den Mietvertrag verpflichtet sich ...').

deciding_facts: whether other things (parking space, cellar, furniture) were let together with the flat
OR Art. 253a Abs. 1.note: Scope rule: Wohn-/Geschäftsraum rules also cover 'Sachen, die der Vermieter zusammen mit diesen Räumen ... überlässt'.

excludes.para_or_article: OR Art. 253a-273c (rules on Wohn- und Geschäftsräume)
excludes.when: the object is a holiday flat rented for at most three months

deciding_facts: whether the object is a holiday flat rented for three months or less
OR Art. 253a Abs. 2.note: 'gelten nicht für Ferienwohnungen, die für höchstens drei Monate gemietet werden'.

OR Art. 253a Abs. 3.note: Delegation to the Federal Council ('Der Bundesrat erlässt die Ausführungsvorschriften'), i.e. the VMWG; no client facts.

deciding_facts: whether the contract is a non-agricultural lease (Pacht) or another contract mainly about letting premises for payment
OR Art. 253b Abs. 1.note: Extends Art. 269 ff. 'sinngemäss' to 'nichtlandwirtschaftliche Pacht- und andere Verträge'.

excludes.when: the flat is luxurious or a single-family house with six or more living rooms (kitchen not counted)

deciding_facts: number of living rooms excluding the kitchen
whether the flat or house is luxurious
OR Art. 253b Abs. 2.note: Premises: luxury Wohnungen / Einfamilienhäuser with six or more rooms (residential only). 'gelten nicht für die Miete von luxuriösen Wohnungen und Einfamilienhäusern mit sechs oder mehr Wohnräumen'.

excludes.when: the housing was publicly subsidised and its rent is controlled by an authority

deciding_facts: whether the flat is publicly subsidised housing whose rent is controlled by an authority
OR Art. 253b Abs. 3.note: Premises: 'Wohnräume' only (subsidised housing). 'Die Bestimmungen über die Anfechtung missbräuchlicher Mietzinse gelten nicht für Wohnräume, deren Bereitstellung von der öffentlichen Hand gefördert wurde'.

deciding_facts: whether getting or keeping the lease was made conditional on another obligation (e.g. buying furniture, taking an insurance) not directly linked to using the flat
OR Art. 254.note: No menu event; only relevant if a coupling deal exists ('Koppelungsgeschäft ... ist nichtig, wenn der Abschluss oder die Weiterführung des Mietvertrags davon abhängig gemacht wird').

deciding_facts: whether the lease states an end date on which it ends without notice
OR Art. 255 Abs. 2.note: Definition of fixed-term: 'wenn es ohne Kündigung mit Ablauf der vereinbarten Dauer endigen soll'.

OR Art. 255 Abs. 3.note: Definition: 'Die übrigen Mietverhältnisse gelten als unbefristet'.

deciding_facts: date the property was handed over versus the agreed date
what the defect is and whether it affects the agreed use
OR Art. 256 Abs. 1.note: Landlord must hand over 'zum vereinbarten Zeitpunkt in einem ... tauglichen Zustand' and keep it so; only matters with a defect (E4) or a handover problem (E20). Narrower reading than treating it as a general rule.

deciding_facts: whether the lease contains a clause shifting maintenance duties onto the tenant
whether that clause is in pre-formulated general terms
OR Art. 256 Abs. 2.note: Deviating clauses to the tenant's detriment are void in 'vorformulierten allgemeinen Geschäftsbedingungen' (lit. a, any lease) or 'Mietverträgen über Wohn- oder Geschäftsräume' (lit. b).

deciding_facts: whether a return protocol was made when the previous tenancy ended
whether the tenant asked to see it at handover
OR Art. 256a Abs. 1.note: 'bei der Übergabe der Sache' to 'dem neuen Mieter auf dessen Verlangen'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant has asked for the previous tenant's rent
OR Art. 256a Abs. 2.note: 'Ebenso kann der Mieter verlangen, dass ihm die Höhe des Mietzinses des vorangegangenen Mietverhältnisses mitgeteilt wird' — no time limit in the text; gated to the start of the tenancy as the narrower reading (it serves the initial-rent challenge, Art. 270).

OR Art. 256b.note: General allocation: 'Der Vermieter trägt die mit der Sache verbundenen Lasten und öffentlichen Abgaben'.

OR Art. 257.note: Definition of rent ('Der Mietzins ist das Entgelt ...').

OR Art. 257a Abs. 1.note: Definition of ancillary costs ('Die Nebenkosten sind das Entgelt ...').

deciding_facts: which ancillary costs the lease specifically lists
OR Art. 257a Abs. 2.note: 'Der Mieter muss die Nebenkosten nur bezahlen, wenn er dies mit dem Vermieter besonders vereinbart hat'.

OR Art. 257b Abs. 1.note: Definition for 'Wohn- und Geschäftsräume': Nebenkosten are 'die tatsächlichen Aufwendungen des Vermieters'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant has received an ancillary-cost statement and asked to see the receipts
OR Art. 257b Abs. 2.note: 'Der Vermieter muss dem Mieter auf Verlangen Einsicht in die Belege gewähren'.

deciding_facts: payment date agreed in the lease or customary locally
OR Art. 257c.note: Default due date 'am Ende jedes Monats', unless 'ein anderer Zeitpunkt vereinbart oder ortsüblich ist'.

deciding_facts: date the payment demand was received
amount and deadline stated in the letter
whether the demand was in writing and threatened termination
whether the amounts claimed were already due rent or ancillary costs
whether the arrears arose after the tenant took over the property
OR Art. 257d Abs. 1.note: 'nach der Übernahme der Sache mit der Zahlung fälliger Mietzinse oder Nebenkosten im Rückstand'; deadline 'mindestens zehn Tage, bei Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen mindestens 30 Tage' (30-day rule limited to Wohn-/Geschäftsräume).

deciding_facts: whether full payment arrived within the deadline
date of the landlord's termination and the end date it names
whether the termination respects at least 30 days to the end of a month
OR Art. 257d Abs. 2.note: 'Bezahlt der Mieter innert der gesetzten Frist nicht, so kann der Vermieter ... kündigen' — needs the deadline letter and either its expiry or a termination; 30 days to month-end for Wohn-/Geschäftsräume, otherwise 'fristlos'.

deciding_facts: form of the deposit (cash or securities)
whether it is held in a bank savings account or deposit in the tenant's name
OR Art. 257e Abs. 1.note: 'Leistet der Mieter von Wohn- oder Geschäftsräumen eine Sicherheit in Geld oder in Wertpapieren'.

deciding_facts: deposit amount compared with the monthly rent
OR Art. 257e Abs. 2.note: Premises: 'Wohnräume' only. 'höchstens drei Monatszinse'. Applies to the demand ('verlangen'), so also at the start of the tenancy (E20).

deciding_facts: date the tenancy ended
whether the landlord has started legal action (payment order or court) within one year of the end
whether both parties have agreed to release the deposit
OR Art. 257e Abs. 3.note: Release only 'mit Zustimmung beider Parteien' or on a 'rechtskräftigen Zahlungsbefehl' / 'Gerichtsurteil'; tenant may claim it back if no claim 'innert einem Jahr nach Beendigung des Mietverhältnisses'. Sentence 1 is not limited to the end of the tenancy, hence E9 as well.

OR Art. 257e Abs. 4.note: Delegation: 'Die Kantone können ergänzende Bestimmungen erlassen'.

OR Art. 257f Abs. 1.note: General duty: 'Der Mieter muss die Sache sorgfältig gebrauchen'.

OR Art. 257f Abs. 2.note: Premises: 'unbewegliche Sache' (includes flats). Duty of 'Rücksicht' towards 'Hausbewohner und Nachbarn'.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord sent a written warning and what it complained of
whether the conduct continued after the warning
whether continuing the tenancy is unbearable for the landlord or other residents
termination date and the period it gives
OR Art. 257f Abs. 3.note: 'Verletzt der Mieter trotz schriftlicher Mahnung ... seine Pflicht ... weiter'; 30 days to month-end 'bei Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen', otherwise 'fristlos'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant is accused of intentionally causing serious damage to the property
OR Art. 257f Abs. 4.note: 'Der Vermieter von Wohn- oder Geschäftsräumen kann jedoch fristlos kündigen, wenn der Mieter vorsätzlich der Sache schweren Schaden zufügt'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant has reported the defect to the landlord and when
OR Art. 257g Abs. 1.note: 'Der Mieter muss Mängel, die er nicht selber zu beseitigen hat, dem Vermieter melden'.

deciding_facts: whether and when the defect was reported
what damage arose from late or missing reporting
OR Art. 257g Abs. 2.note: 'Unterlässt der Mieter die Meldung, so haftet er für den Schaden'.

deciding_facts: purpose of the works (removing defects, preventing damage)
OR Art. 257h Abs. 1.note: 'Der Mieter muss Arbeiten an der Sache dulden, wenn sie zur Beseitigung von Mängeln ... notwendig sind'.

deciding_facts: purpose of the viewing (maintenance, sale, re-letting)
OR Art. 257h Abs. 2.note: Viewings 'soweit dies für den Unterhalt, den Verkauf oder die Wiedervermietung notwendig ist'.

deciding_facts: how far in advance works or viewings were announced
how the works affect the tenant's use (for rent reduction / damages)
OR Art. 257h Abs. 3.note: Landlord must announce 'rechtzeitig' and take account of tenant's interests; reserves Art. 259d/259e.

deciding_facts: whether the property was handed over on the agreed date
whether defects at handover exclude or seriously impair the agreed use
OR Art. 258 Abs. 1.note: 'Übergibt der Vermieter die Sache nicht zum vereinbarten Zeitpunkt oder mit Mängeln ...' -> Art. 107-109.

excludes.when: the tenant took over the property despite the defects and insists on proper performance

deciding_facts: whether the defect existed at handover
whether the tenant took over the property despite it and insists on proper performance
OR Art. 258 Abs. 2.note: 'Übernimmt der Mieter die Sache trotz dieser Mängel ... kann er nur die Ansprüche geltend machen' of Art. 259a-259i.

deciding_facts: whether the defect existed at handover
how seriously it affects use
OR Art. 258 Abs. 3.note: 259a-259i also for minor defects at handover ('wenn die Sache bei der Übergabe Mängel hat').

deciding_facts: whether the defect can be fixed by small cleaning or repairs under local custom
OR Art. 259.note: 'Mängel, die durch kleine ... Reinigungen oder Ausbesserungen behoben werden können' at the tenant's cost.

deciding_facts: what the defect or disturbance is and since when
whether the tenant caused it
whether it is a small repair the tenant must do (Art. 259)
whether the landlord has been told
OR Art. 259a Abs. 1.note: 'Entstehen an der Sache Mängel ... oder wird der Mieter im vertragsgemässen Gebrauch der Sache gestört'.

OR Art. 259a Abs. 2.note: Premises: 'unbewegliche Sache' (includes flats). Rent may be deposited ('hinterlegen').

deciding_facts: whether the landlord knows of the defect
whether a reasonable deadline to fix it has passed
how severely the defect affects use
OR Art. 259b.note: 'Kennt der Vermieter einen Mangel und beseitigt er ihn nicht innert angemessener Frist': immediate termination (serious) or substitute repair (minor).

excludes.when: the landlord provides a full replacement for the defective thing within a reasonable time

deciding_facts: whether the landlord offered a full replacement within a reasonable time
OR Art. 259c.note: 'keinen Anspruch auf Beseitigung des Mangels, wenn der Vermieter ... vollwertigen Ersatz leistet'.

deciding_facts: date the landlord learned of the defect
extent of the impairment
whether and when the defect was fixed
OR Art. 259d.note: Reduction 'vom Zeitpunkt, in dem er vom Mangel erfahren hat, bis zur Behebung'.

deciding_facts: damage the tenant suffered from the defect (costs, damaged belongings)
whether the landlord can show no fault
OR Art. 259e.note: 'Hat der Mieter durch den Mangel Schaden erlitten'.

deciding_facts: whether a third party claims a right to the property that conflicts with the tenant's
whether the tenant notified the landlord
OR Art. 259f.note: 'Erhebt ein Dritter einen Anspruch auf die Sache' — a disturbance of use, hence E4.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant set the landlord a reasonable deadline in writing
whether the deposit was threatened and then announced in writing
which cantonal office accepts rent deposits
OR Art. 259g Abs. 1.note: Premises: 'Mieter einer unbeweglichen Sache' (includes flats). Written deadline and written announcement required.

deciding_facts: whether rent has actually been deposited following Abs. 1
OR Art. 259g Abs. 2.note: Premises: unbewegliche Sache (follows Abs. 1). 'Mit der Hinterlegung gelten die Mietzinse als bezahlt'.

deciding_facts: due date of the first deposited rent
whether the tenant filed claims with the conciliation authority within 30 days of it
OR Art. 259h Abs. 1.note: Premises: unbewegliche Sache (rent deposit). '... nicht innert 30 Tagen seit Fälligkeit des ersten hinterlegten Mietzinses bei der Schlichtungsbehörde geltend gemacht'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant has announced a rent deposit
OR Art. 259h Abs. 2.note: Premises: unbewegliche Sache. Landlord may claim 'zu Unrecht hinterlegten Mietzinse' once deposit announced.

OR Art. 259i.note: Premises: unbewegliche Sache (rent-deposit procedure). 'Das Verfahren richtet sich nach der ZPO'.

deciding_facts: what renovations or changes the landlord plans
whether they are reasonable for the tenant
whether the tenancy has been terminated
OR Art. 260 Abs. 1.note: Only 'wenn sie für den Mieter zumutbar sind und wenn das Mietverhältnis nicht gekündigt ist'.

deciding_facts: how the works affect the tenant's use (for rent reduction / damages)
OR Art. 260 Abs. 2.note: 'auf die Interessen des Mieters Rücksicht nehmen'; reserves Art. 259d/259e.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant has made or plans renovations or changes
whether the landlord consented in writing
OR Art. 260a Abs. 1.note: No menu event; only relevant if the tenant changes the property ('nur vornehmen, wenn der Vermieter schriftlich zugestimmt hat').

deciding_facts: whether the landlord consented to the tenant's changes
whether restoring the original state was agreed in writing
OR Art. 260a Abs. 2.note: Restoration only 'wenn dies schriftlich vereinbart worden ist'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant's consented changes add considerable value at the end
any written compensation agreement
OR Art. 260a Abs. 3.note: 'bei Beendigung des Mietverhältnisses ... einen erheblichen Mehrwert' — needs the end of the tenancy to be pending or past.

deciding_facts: date of the sale or transfer
whether the lease was concluded before it
OR Art. 261 Abs. 1.note: 'Veräussert der Vermieter die Sache nach Abschluss des Mietvertrags ... geht das Mietverhältnis ... auf den Erwerber über'.

deciding_facts: whether the new owner claims urgent own need for himself, close relatives or in-laws
statutory notice period and termination date applied
OR Art. 261 Abs. 2.note: lit. a 'bei Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen' (urgent own need); lit. b other things. Gated on E12; a termination itself is not required to discuss the risk.

deciding_facts: earliest date the original lease allowed termination
damage caused by the earlier termination
OR Art. 261 Abs. 3.note: 'Kündigt der neue Eigentümer früher, als es der Vertrag ... gestattet hätte, so haftet dieser' (the former landlord).

OR Art. 261 Abs. 4.note: 'Vorbehalten bleiben die Bestimmungen über die Enteignung' — expropriation has no menu event; gated on E12 as the narrower reading.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord granted a third party a limited real right (e.g. usufruct) amounting to a change of owner
OR Art. 261a.note: '... ein beschränktes dingliches Recht einräumt und dies einem Eigentümerwechsel gleichkommt'.

deciding_facts: whether the lease is annotated in the land register
OR Art. 261b Abs. 1.note: Premises: Grundstück (includes flats). 'kann verabredet werden, dass das Verhältnis im Grundbuch vorgemerkt wird' — option, no event.

excludes.when: the lease is annotated in the land register (the new owner must let the tenant use the property as agreed)

deciding_facts: whether the lease is annotated in the land register
OR Art. 261b Abs. 2.note: Premises: Grundstück (includes flats). 'jeder neue Eigentümer dem Mieter gestatten muss, das Grundstück entsprechend dem Mietvertrag zu gebrauchen'. The exclusion of Art. 261 Abs. 2 is inferred from this effect; the text has no explicit cross-reference.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord has consented to the sublease
OR Art. 262 Abs. 1.note: 'mit Zustimmung des Vermieters ganz oder teilweise untervermieten'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant disclosed the sublease terms
sublease rent compared with main rent
what disadvantages the landlord claims
OR Art. 262 Abs. 2.note: Refusal only on the three listed grounds ('kann die Zustimmung nur verweigern, wenn').

deciding_facts: how the subtenant uses the property
OR Art. 262 Abs. 3.note: 'Der Mieter haftet dem Vermieter dafür, dass der Untermieter die Sache nicht anders gebraucht'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant of business premises wants to transfer the lease to a third party
OR Art. 263 Abs. 1.note: 'Der Mieter von Geschäftsräumen kann das Mietverhältnis ... auf einen Dritten übertragen'. No menu event.

deciding_facts: the landlord's reason for refusing the transfer
OR Art. 263 Abs. 2.note: Business premises (follows Abs. 1). 'nur aus wichtigem Grund verweigern'.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord consented to the transfer
OR Art. 263 Abs. 3.note: Business premises. 'tritt der Dritte anstelle des Mieters'.

deciding_facts: date of the transfer and the earliest contractual/legal end date
OR Art. 263 Abs. 4.note: Business premises. Joint liability 'höchstens aber für zwei Jahre'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant's notice respects the notice period and date
whether the tenant proposed a replacement tenant who is solvent, acceptable and willing to take over on the same terms
OR Art. 264 Abs. 1.note: 'Gibt der Mieter die Sache zurück, ohne Kündigungsfrist oder -termin einzuhalten'. E2 included because the early exit is usually decided before the return.

deciding_facts: earliest date the tenancy ends or could be ended under the lease or law
OR Art. 264 Abs. 2.note: Otherwise rent is owed 'bis zu dem Zeitpunkt, in dem das Mietverhältnis ... endet oder beendet werden kann'.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord re-let the property or refused a suitable replacement
OR Art. 264 Abs. 3.note: Landlord must credit savings and what he gains 'oder absichtlich zu gewinnen unterlassen hat'.

deciding_facts: whether the lease contains an advance waiver of set-off
OR Art. 265.note: 'können nicht im Voraus auf das Recht verzichten, ... zu verrechnen'.

deciding_facts: agreed end date of the lease
OR Art. 266 Abs. 1.note: 'endet das Mietverhältnis ohne Kündigung mit Ablauf dieser Dauer'.

excludes.when: the parties tacitly continued the tenancy after the agreed end (it becomes open-ended)

deciding_facts: whether the tenant stayed and rent was accepted after the agreed end date
OR Art. 266 Abs. 2.note: 'Setzen die Parteien das Mietverhältnis stillschweigend fort, so gilt es als unbefristetes Mietverhältnis'.

deciding_facts: whether the lease is open-ended
notice period and termination dates agreed in the lease
OR Art. 266a Abs. 1.note: Open-ended lease ('unbefristete') with statutory 'Fristen und Termine' unless longer agreed.

deciding_facts: date notice was received and the end date it names
OR Art. 266a Abs. 2.note: 'Halten die Parteien die Frist oder den Termin nicht ein, so gilt die Kündigung für den nächstmöglichen Termin'.

deciding_facts: local customary termination dates
OR Art. 266b.note: Premises: 'unbewegliche Sachen und Fahrnisbauten' (flats are governed by the special rule Art. 266c). Three months.

deciding_facts: local customary termination dates
date notice was received
OR Art. 266c.note: Premises: 'Wohnungen' only. 'mit einer Frist von drei Monaten auf einen ortsüblichen Termin'.

deciding_facts: local customary termination dates
OR Art. 266d.note: 'Bei der Miete von Geschäftsräumen ... sechs Monaten'.

deciding_facts: whether the object is a furnished room or a separately let parking space
OR Art. 266e.note: Premises: 'möblierten Zimmern und von gesondert vermieteten Einstellplätzen'. Two weeks to end of a one-month period.

deciding_facts: what important reason is invoked
why continuing the contract is unbearable for that party
OR Art. 266g Abs. 1.note: 'Aus wichtigen Gründen, welche die Vertragserfüllung ... unzumutbar machen'.

deciding_facts: whether the termination was made for important reasons (Abs. 1)
OR Art. 266g Abs. 2.note: 'Der Richter bestimmt die vermögensrechtlichen Folgen der vorzeitigen Kündigung'.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord set the tenant and the bankruptcy administration a reasonable written deadline for security
OR Art. 266h Abs. 1.note: 'Fällt der Mieter nach Übernahme der Sache in Konkurs'.

deciding_facts: whether security was provided within the deadline
OR Art. 266h Abs. 2.note: 'Erhält der Vermieter innert dieser Frist keine Sicherheit, so kann er fristlos kündigen'.

deciding_facts: date of death
who the heirs are
OR Art. 266i.note: 'Stirbt der Mieter, so können seine Erben ... kündigen'.

deciding_facts: whether the rented movable is for private use and let by a commercial lessor
OR Art. 266k.note: Premises: movable thing for private use rented from a commercial lessor.

deciding_facts: whether the notice was given in writing
OR Art. 266l Abs. 1.note: 'Vermieter und Mieter von Wohn- und Geschäftsräumen müssen schriftlich kündigen'.

deciding_facts: whether the landlord's termination used the official cantonal form stating how to contest it or request an extension

deciding_facts: whether the spouse expressly consented to the tenant's notice
OR Art. 266m Abs. 1.note: 'Dient die gemietete Sache als Wohnung der Familie, kann ein Ehegatte ... nur mit der ausdrücklichen Zustimmung des anderen kündigen'.

deciding_facts: whether consent could not be obtained or was refused without good reason
OR Art. 266m Abs. 2.note: '... so kann er den Richter anrufen'.

deciding_facts: whether the tenant is in a registered partnership
whether the termination or payment-deadline notice was delivered separately to the spouse or registered partner

deciding_facts: whether the notice was in writing
whether the landlord used the official form
whether spouse consent / separate delivery requirements were met
OR Art. 266o.note: 'Die Kündigung ist nichtig, wenn sie den Artikeln 266l–266n nicht entspricht'.

deciding_facts: condition of the property compared with normal contractual use
OR Art. 267 Abs. 1.note: 'Der Mieter muss die Sache in dem Zustand zurückgeben, der sich aus dem vertragsgemässen Gebrauch ergibt' — relevant once the end is pending or past.

deciding_facts: whether the lease requires a fixed payment at the end beyond actual damage (e.g. flat-rate cleaning or renovation fee)

deciding_facts: whether a handover inspection took place and defects were notified immediately

deciding_facts: whether the landlord reported defects immediately at the return

deciding_facts: when the landlord discovered the hidden defect and when he reported it

deciding_facts: amount of overdue rent (annual and current half-year)
which movables are in the premises

deciding_facts: whether the subtenant has paid his rent

excludes.when: the items could not be seized by the tenant's creditors

deciding_facts: whether the items are exempt from seizure

deciding_facts: whether items belong to third parties or were stolen/lost
